tally: Arkansas Secretary of State, results service: 2024 General Election and Nonpartisan Judicial Runoff Election (election 1846)

notes: The Secretary of State's results site, linked from its Election Results page (https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/elections/research/election-results); read through its keyless data service (https://enr-results-api.totalresults.com/, client arkansas): the election, its contest list, each county's results with its precinct rows (states_cache/ar_local/results/20241105/tally/county/), and the contest-wide results of every contest shown in more than one county (contest/). Every answer is marked isOfficial; the service's lastUpdated is 2025-12-16T19:41:49.5225815Z (the Secretary moved its past elections to this vendor's service in December 2025). The SHA-256 is of the contest list; every file is kept.
gaps: Arkansas prints an unopposed candidate on the general election ballot only for a few offices (the State Board of Election Commissioners' County Board manual); the rest are declared elected without a vote, so those offices are not in the results.
Runoffs four weeks after the general election

A county or city office where nobody had more than half the votes went to a runoff four weeks later (the State Board of Election Commissioners' County Board manual). The results service does not hold those runoffs, so those contests have no winner marked here.
